direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary #A8F04A on #050705, one per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible focus ring on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, never conflating controls or status; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the extra logo card at the top of the inspector; retain only the header logo here and reserve the second placement for the opening story.
Enlarge the 120 versus 80 tracks and align their labels, values and DOES NOT MATCH span on one shared baseline for instant comparison.
Raise low-contrast machine and evidence text to silverDim minimum and add a visible focus ring to each focusable SVG node.
Separate ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT, including nonce and identity status, from INVESTIGATION - SOURCE EVIDENCE with distinct headings, borders and status text so the controls are never conflated.
Enlarge the route selector to a 40px target and pair its offline state with text and marker, not colour alone.
Shorten the inspector empty-state copy to one sentence so Run Sample investigation remains the single clear primary.
Keep the typed consent form tied to the selected substitute path, with plan identifier, exact phrase and 0/27 count grouped as one labelled form.
Make the disabled Accept control explain its state beside the field and preserve a focus ring when focus moves to it after exact entry.
Compress option-card vertical padding slightly so all three paths and the consent form fit without inspector crowding at 1366x768.
Prevent the third proposed task from clipping at the inspector edge; give the task list a bounded internal scroll area with a visible end marker.
Repeat PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on the board header and each task so the untracked state survives scanning.
Align task owner, due offset and dependency in tabular columns and enlarge Decline and Approve targets to 40px.
Distinguish the dashed PREVIEW state for CELL-MILL-2 from the later solid red stopped state with explicit WILL GO OFFLINE text and pattern.
Place the invalidation consequence directly beside the machine selector and repeat it in the DecisionBar status centre.
Reduce the muted Scenario management block contrast hierarchy so Apply second shock remains the only primary emphasis.
Keep stopped CELL-MILL-2 in stoppedRed with cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text, and ensure no feasible route line passes through it.
Keep pre-flight route health visually separate from the investigation task while showing CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE - 3 to 2 feasible paths above the SVG.
Enlarge the constrained-capacity note under Split available capacity so the changed feasibility reads without inspector interaction.
Show the constrained Split path as unavailable with pattern, cross marker and reason text, never as a selectable recovery option.
Anchor the revised typed consent form to the selected substitute path and state PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED beside the disabled Accept control.
Align finish and incremental cost columns across all three paths using tabular figures for faster comparison.
Keep the 3 BLOCKED prior tasks in a clearly bounded group beside the approved revised plan, distinct from the untracked replacement proposal below.
Prevent horizontal clipping of blocked-task reasons; wrap to two lines or expand within the internal scroll list.
Add owner, due offset and dependency columns to replacement tasks t1 and t2 with consistent tabular alignment.
Remove the duplicate Verify ledger primary: keep the sequenced control in the inspector and use DecisionBar only for status and the next enabled retention action.
Number Verify, Seal and Retain as a locked sequence, disabling each later step until the prior step completes on the current ledger.
Clarify the separate export passphrase rule with length and character-type feedback adjacent to the field, without implying a result.
Replace the absent primary with a single clearly labelled completion action or an explicit terminal-state label, leaving Back as secondary.
Keep PACKET SEALED, 18 events, revised plan accepted and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained as one compact completion summary in the DecisionBar.
Give the sealed ledger banner a pattern and text marker in addition to its border so completion is not carried by colour alone.
